behavior: Invoice history is a table: Event, By, Details and Time columns, each event in a category, filtered by category
acceptance: The History panel is a table from medium screens up (Event with a category mark, By, Details, Time) and two-line rows on phones
Each history kind has a label, a category (payment, change or email) and its own details: amounts with token, network, the transaction link; an unknown kind shows its name as a change
The filter shows All, Payments, Changes or Emails
R-124 and DESIGN.md describe the table; unit, lint and typecheck pass
notes: 2026-10-23 review fail by reviewer: No history kind maps to the email category (apps/web/src/features/invoices/constants/invoices.ts:59-73; payer.email_given is a change at :62), so the Emails filter always shows 'Nothing here yet.' and the info dot that DESIGN.md:413 names never renders. Map payer.email_given to email, or get the owner's call if Emails is meant for sent emails, which are not history kinds yet; make R-124 say which kinds each category holds. Everything else checks out: all 13 backend kinds have labels; paid and settled use the shown option's amount, held uses its row's option; table semantics are right; unit and typecheck pass.
